scope: ReplayRun owned-kind class-declared identity + tape-pair grammar. The owned kind has exactly ONE legal spelling ('replay'); the class-ref spelling is illegal by the owned-kind doctrine and, for execution docs, is the F3 broker's follow-on concern (documented scope boundary, not a hidden gap).
non_goals: class-ref spelling enforcement inside execution docs (F3 broker follow-on)
pair on every P4 replay admission

registration.class: ReplayRun(Node) in dskit/pipeline/trust.py (no new file). It imports Node from node.py; document.py imports NOTHING from trust, so no cycle.
registration.register: trust.py gains register(); dskit/pipeline/__init__.py imports and calls it: register_node_kind(REPLAY_RUN_KIND, ReplayRun, owned=True).
registration.class_contract: role="replay"; non-empty outputs tuple; default-deny validate_params (refuses any space param); run() RAISES an honest refusal (replay execution requires the F3 composed-tape broker, follow-on).

enforcement.parse: dskit/pipeline/document.py at PipelineDocument.from_obj level (document context): a node whose NodeSpec.uses == REPLAY_RUN_KIND must be in an execution_backtest document AND declare inputs exactly {tape_manifest, tape_data}, each a complete P5 descriptor. A non-execution document referencing REPLAY_RUN_KIND refuses. This is the single reachable enforcement point for execution docs.
enforcement.plan: planner.py, stat_test precedent: resolved.cls.role == "replay" requires owned=True (refuses class-ref/custom-role spellings) for ordinary documents. (Unreachable for execution docs, which refuse_execution_backtest excludes; the class-ref spelling in execution docs is the F3 broker's follow-on.)

positive_grammar: inputs == {tape_manifest: {$captured_artifact: D1}, tape_data: {$captured_artifact: D2}}; D1, D2 each an exact P5 six-field descriptor.

cases: a third input key beside the pair
a renamed port carrying a descriptor
a descriptor as a list/map input value
a non-ReplayRun node declaring the two ports not swept
a class-ref/custom class with role='replay' refused as non-owned on ordinary docs

compatibility.p4_replay: pair rule fires only on the ReplayRun owned kind; accepted P4 final-replay fixtures remain green.
compatibility.p5_p6: descriptor shape and generic equality unchanged.
compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production; trust.py is stdlib-only.

forbidden_effects: planning/stage compilation completes before grammar refusal
node/adapter import or construction before refusal
uses-string resemblance or document role key as identity authority

tests.new: tests/pipeline/test_replay_tape_descriptors.py: positive pair; missing/extra/aliased/nested/wrong_name/identity; non-execution replay-kind refusal; class-ref/custom role='replay' owned refusal on ordinary docs; ReplayRun.run() refusal; one-name pin (ReplayRun.role == 'replay' == REPLAY_RUN_KIND == owned kind).
tests.census: extend tests/pipeline/test_serving_effect.py KIND_EFFECTS and add ReplayRun default-deny validate_params so test_foreach census passes.
